source_units.text: I will help run a classroom usability study.
Prepare a learning schedule for facilitating the sessions.
The syllabus consists of "Task Scenarios", "Think-aloud Prompts", "Usability Findings"; each named topic needs a minimum of 25 minutes in total.
My study window closes on 2027-02-03; that date is still available.
The total of all sessions on any one date must not exceed 40 minutes.
